_about: Sample fixture-root record (proposal v11, section 2.6, SET-R7-2). An entry of kind fixture-root in bindings.json under the CodeFlow authority root, whose location comes from the account database, never HOME or XDG_STATE_HOME. Written only by the operator's `codeflow baseline bind --fixture-root <path>` and removed only by `codeflow baseline bind --remove-fixture-root <path>`. A fixture seat's CODEFLOW_ADMISSION carries authority root, fixture root, admission_id and trial real path; a record removed, or replaced (another admission_id, or another device or inode at the same path), is binding lost for every trial under it.
root: <real path of the harness-created temporary root, for example under the operator's TMPDIR>
builtin_floor: <identity of the admitting binary's built-in policy>
remote_actions: refused, except push or fetch to a local repository eligible under this root
